serves: DOMAINS.md invariant 40: the worker stores that last segment only if it is the playlist's last one and its length is within 1.5 seconds of the playlist's. PRODUCT.md: Seeking and resuming just work; every failure is reported with its reason, never silent; Failures are invisible.
